{{Quote|Hello! Anyone here?|Zeerid Korr entering the abandoned Nebula|<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />}}
The '''Nebula''' was a ten-story [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] located near the [[Liston Spaceport]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The building had [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] and stairs that had access to the roof.<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />

During the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" /> around [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> many buildings on the galactic capital planet were destroyed. Although the Nebula was abandoned, it remained mostly intact, aside from losing power and suffering a few broken [[Window/Legends|windows]]. After the Sacking, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] used the Nebula to monitor the nearby [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]-held Liston Spaceport. He climbed to the Nebula's roof to look for any [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]], who he was working with, could use to leave the planet.<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nebula appeared in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]] and first published in [[2011]].<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />
